what.en: Abridged from Rafailov, R., Sharma, A., Mitchell, E., Ermon, S., Manning, C. D. and Finn, C. (2023) “Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model”, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36 (NeurIPS 2023), arXiv:2305.18290v3. Sections 2 and 5.2, most of 6 and appendices A.2–A.4, A.6 and B–E cut, other paragraphs and sentences shortened; section numbers kept, equations renumbered in the abridged order; citations re-set author–year; Figure 1 redrawn
what.es: Abreviado de Rafailov, R., Sharma, A., Mitchell, E., Ermon, S., Manning, C. D. y Finn, C. (2023) «Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model», Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36 (NeurIPS 2023), arXiv:2305.18290v3. Sin las secciones 2 y 5.2, la mayor parte de la 6 ni los apéndices A.2–A.4, A.6 y B–E; otros párrafos y frases recortados; se conservan los números de sección y las ecuaciones se renumeran en el orden del resumen; citas en autor–año; figura 1 redibujada
